title: Signal log line
description: One line of a signal library's day index, log/<type>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.jsonl, where the day is the day the signal was published to the library (everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md). Append-only: a library adds a line when it publishes a signal and never rewrites one, so a pull reads only the days after its cursor. A retraction is a new signal with its own line.

path.description: The signal's file, relative to the library root

published.description: When the library published it, a UTC timestamp on the line's day
